findings: The learner overview and summary describe 北 as a sound-based loan for “north,” but do not identify the unknown earlier word whose sound supposedly prompted the reuse. The current takeaway only says the source word is unknown and does not explain the mechanism. Revise `learner.overview.text` (and `summary.text`) to say that the proposed account is that 北 was reused to write a different word pronounced similarly; the word and precise sound match are unknown. This is needed to make the borrowing explanation self-contained without implying an established sound match. Cite the existing evidence for the proposal and its limits, such as X-828693834a0eb8341c22 and X-db2c6cf0c63664159944.
